newsitem.title: UK: Baltic Freight Index up 2, freight market quiet.
newsitem.headline: Baltic Freight Index up 2, freight market quiet.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index BFI was up two on Friday at 1,283 in quieter conditions ahead of Monday's holiday on the European Continent.

Brokers reported an unchanged fixture by MFK of Militos for 54,000 heavy grains US Gulf/Japan 9-16 June at $21.20 no combo. But they said that reports were also circulating that Korean charterers were firm for June loading on this route at $21.50.
Brokers also reported improving conditons for Caper tonnage in the Atlantic.
